jobs.title: Custom Software Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : Python (Programming Language) Good to have skills: NA Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification: 15 years full time education Summary: As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves developing tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. The role requires working with modern frameworks and following agile methodologies to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Collaboration with different teams and continuous enhancement of software performance are integral parts of the daily routine, fostering innovation and adaptability in a dynamic work environment. Roles & Responsibilities: - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead efforts to identify and implement process improvements that enhance team productivity and software quality. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and skill development. Professional & Technical Skills: Must Have Skills Core Python(Programming Language) backend Development - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle and agile methodologies. - Experience with modern software frameworks and tools for building scalable applications. - Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. - Familiarity with debugging, testing, and performance optimization techniques. - Strong hands-on production Python Object-oriented programming and SOLID principles Modular/service-oriented design Design patterns and type hints/typing. - Experience owning production backend services FastAPI & REST API Development Strong production REST API development FastAPI preferred comparable frameworks such as Flask/Django REST Framework can be considered if the candidate has strong API engineering depth - API contracts, request/response validation and error handling Unicorn/ASGI exposure beneficial Resilience & Failure Handling Timeouts and retry mechanisms - Exponential backoff Idempotency/idempotency keys Circuit breaker patterns Failure recovery and stale-data fallback Optimistic concurrency. - Understanding of resilient external integrations Asynchronous Programming & Concurrency asyncio async/await Non-blocking I/O Asynchronous workers/background processing. - Concurrent API/integration processing Testing / TDD Strong automated testing experience pytest Mocking Unit, component and integration testing TDD practices. - Data Validation Pedantic Typed domain models JSON/schema validation - Handling complex API payloads Secure API Development OAuth2/OIDC RBAC Secrets management mTLS Secure coding practices. - Database Integration MongoDB/NoSQL or relational database integration PyMongo/Motor preferred for this particular role. - Transactional/data consistency patterns: Transactional Outbox experience is particularly valuable Observability Structured logging Metrics and monitoring Correlation IDs/tracing Production troubleshooting. - Good-to-Have Skills MongoDB with PyMongo/Motor Transactional Outbox pattern Circuit breaker/bulkhead patterns Docker and Kubernetes CI/CD pipelines Git/GitHub/Azure DevOps Cloud experience with Azure, AWS or GCP OpenAPI/Swagger Microservices architecture Message/event-based integration, such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk, Application Insights or comparable observability platforms Maker-checker / segregation-of-duties implementation experience Experience contributing to backend architecture/design decisions. - Production incident diagnosis and troubleshooting Mentoring/supporting other Python engineers AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, including reviewing, validating and correcting generated code. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Python (Programming Language). - This position is based at our Gurugram office. - A 15 years full time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education 5-10 Yrs Processing, Asynchronous, Business Requirements, Automation testing, Backend, Agile methodology, Azure Devops, Application
